name: Tajikistan

nso.name: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan (Agentii omori nazdi Prezidenti Jumhurii Tojikiston)

latest_census.notes: Censuses in 2000, 2010 and October 2020. The questionnaire follows the Soviet programme: nationality (millat), native language and other languages spoken are asked; religion has never been an item. The 2010 results were released as themed volumes; the 2020 round's detailed ethnic volume may or may not be out.

subnational_sources.title: Perepis naseleniya i zhilishchnogo fonda Respubliki Tadzhikistan 2010 goda, Tom III: Natsionalnyi sostav, vladenie yazykami i grazhdanstvo naseleniya Respubliki Tadzhikistan (2010 census Volume III: national composition, language proficiency and citizenship)
subnational_sources.publisher: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan (Dushanbe, 2012)
subnational_sources.evidence: Volume III is the known publication of ethnicity and native language; it tabulates by the five top-level units (Dushanbe, Sughd, Khatlon, GBAO, Districts of Republican Subordination = the packet's admin1, 5) and by city and rayon (the packet's admin2, 58, is in the right range). It circulated as a PDF; no machine-readable edition is recalled.

subnational_sources.title: 2020 census results (Natijahoi baruykhatgirii aholi va fondi manzil 2020), ethnic composition volume
subnational_sources.publisher: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan
subnational_sources.evidence: The 2020 census asked the same items; whether the ethnic-composition volume with a rayon breakdown has been published is not recalled. Look on stat.tj first, then fall back to 2010.

tier_reason: Census counts of ethnicity and native language by oblast and rayon exist (2010 Volume III, possibly 2020), but as PDF volumes, not tables; religion is not asked.
recommended_action: Crawl stat.tj for the 2020 census result volumes; if an ethnic-composition volume by rayon is there, extract it, otherwise extract 2010 Volume III. Both levels join: 5 oblast-level units and about 58 rayons/cities (watch the DRS rayons, which are listed under 'Districts of Republican Subordination' rather than an oblast, and rayons renamed since 2010, e.g. Tavildara -> Sangvor, Nosiri Khusrav). Declare religion not_collected with the Soviet-programme reason.
not_found: A machine-readable (XLS/CSV) edition of the 2010 or 2020 ethnic tables
Publication status of the 2020 ethnic-composition volume
Exact rayon count in Volume III
summary: Tajikistan's censuses (2000, 2010, 2020) ask nationality and native language but never religion, which is a not_collected declaration. The 2010 census Volume III (national composition, language proficiency and citizenship) tabulates both fields by oblast and by city/rayon, which lines up with the packet's 5 admin1 and 58 admin2 shapes, but it is a PDF volume. The 2020 equivalent should be checked on stat.tj before extracting 2010. Tier B for the PDF-only format and rayon renamings since 2010.
